    tl.store(out + offs, res, mask=mask)

def _copy_kernel(inp, out, TOTAL:tl.constexpr, BLOCK:tl.constexpr):
    pid = tl.program_id(0); offs = pid * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK); mask=offs<TOTAL
    tl.store(out+offs, tl.load(inp+offs, mask=mask, other=0.0), mask=mask)

class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self): super().__init__()
    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        x=x.contiguous(); B=x.shape[0]; N=x.shape[1]; y=torch.empty_like(x); total=B*N; block=256; grid=(triton.cdiv(total, block),)
        if N==1:
            _copy_kernel[grid](x,y,total,BLOCK=block); return y
        last=N//2
        if last==1:
            _had_stage_kernel[grid](x,y,total,N,1,BLOCK=block); return y
        tmp_a=torch.empty_like(x); tmp_b=torch.empty_like(x)
        _had_stage_kernel[grid](x,tmp_a,total,N,1,BLOCK=block)
        src=tmp_a; dst=tmp_b; stride=2
        while stride<last:
            _had_stage_kernel[grid](src,dst,total,N,stride,BLOCK=block); src,dst=dst,src; stride*=2
        _had_stage_kernel[grid](src,y,total,N,last,BLOCK=block)
        return y
